deck_title: Stokes exact exponential viscous drag integrator vs naive Forward Euler velocity reversal rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic George Gabriel Stokes (1851) exact exponential viscous drag integration (v(dt) = v0 * exp(-gamma * dt) > 0 across 17 supercritical dimensionless drag steps tau = gamma * dt = 1 + 2u in [1.0000, 3.0000], guaranteeing strictly positive forward velocity with zero sign reversal and locking total kinetic-plus-dissipated work-energy ratio e^(-2*tau) + (1 - e^(-2*tau)) = 1.0000x with 0/17 reversed stations) versus naive explicit Forward Euler linear drag (v_next = v0 * (1 - gamma * dt) = -2u * v0 < 0, which violates the Second Law of Thermodynamics by propelling particles backward at speed 2u*v0 and inflating the velocity excursion ratio as 1 + 2u to 1.5000x at tau=1.50, 2.0000x at tau=2.00, and 3.0000x / -2.00v0 at tau=3.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-substep viscous dissipation quadrature.

Frame-rate independent camera velocity damping and character air-resistance controllers
Analytical position integration x_next = x + (v0 / gamma) * (1 - exp(-gamma * dt)) alongside v_next = v0 * exp(-gamma * dt)
Unconditionally positive velocity decay immune to frame drops (dt spikes) and high drag coefficients gamma
not_for: Active thruster propulsion where force is intentionally applied in the reverse direction
